note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Butte RD) on Delmoe Lake, an irrigation reservoir whose level drops through the summer, in the Whitetail-Pipestone OHV area 15 mi from Whitehall and Butte: I-90 Homestake exit 233, about 10 mi north on gravel FS Rd 222 (Forest Service: suitable for passenger vehicles; watch for OHVs), then 0.5 mi on FS Rd 9371. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page confirms FCFS, 25 sites, 32-ft max trailer, water, $15/night (+$5 extra vehicle); added vault toilets, 16-day limit, season (Memorial Day to Labor Day / mid-Sept, two wordings) and a TEMPORARY CLOSURE for construction (Forest Order 01020426-01, April 1 - Oct 31, 2026). Not stated: hookups, pull-throughs. Note trimmed of the restated count, length, water/toilet and FCFS text.
